trailhead.label: Start here, Passo Sella, paid parking lot behind Hotel Passo Sella

cautions: The SS242 road at Passo Sella, with traffic and buses, at the start and finish.
Scree crossings under the north face of the Sassolungo and below the Rifugio Vicenza.
The edge of the Città dei Sassi boulder field.
Carry water even though water points are listed.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
